description: This file defines an ExceptionListener class for a Symfony-based PHP application. It handles exceptions globally, logging detailed traces, managing error responses, and redirecting on certain conditions. It includes methods for custom exception tracing, logging, and response customization, indicating its role as an integral part of the application's error handling subsystem.

classes.name: ExceptionListener
classes.description: A listener class for handling kernel exceptions and request events within a Symfony-based PHP application.

methods.name: jTraceEx
methods.description: Provides a Java style exception trace as an array of formatted strings.

methods.name: logException
methods.description: Logs detailed information about an exception, differentiating error types.

methods.name: onKernelRequest
methods.description: Handles kernel request events, redirecting to maintenance page if configured.

methods.name: onKernelException
methods.description: Manages exceptions thrown during request processing, logging and setting appropriate responses, including support for JSON responses and error pages.

methods.name: onKernelTerminate
methods.description: Performs cleanup tasks after a response is sent, such as sending delayed emails.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Registers the event listeners for Symfony kernel events.
